notes: The native Maxina app (apps/mobile) has no staging/production web host and no production profile (collaboration §7a). Parity for this lane is proven by the fixture / fake-gateway Jest suites below, each rendering the ported screens in their loaded / empty / error states with no network. The suites and the exact states they cover are listed per-file so this file does not overstate coverage. Device-runtime parity (plan §8) is deferred to the G1 owner gate and is NOT a merge blocker.
